summary: The First Den is a seeded forest world around Spawn, with farms, Mirror Tarn, Garden and Market districts, a hilltop village, and now an expanding Stormwind capital along the King's Road. Authored cell scenes combine terrain-marked sites, reusable procedural architecture, activities, crowds and wildlife; the player uses WoW-style movement, bending combat and Wynx the rideable/following gryphon, while Wunix switches between fox and owl forms.
places: places/main/config.yaml - single seeded forest place; terrain, site clearings/grades, paths, water and material/environment bands; Stormwind city flat, raised keep plateau, causeway, canals and moat marks are centered north of Spawn.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn, The First Den/home, farms and many authored landmarks, activities and manager roots; King's Road signs point north toward Stormwind.
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene - Ember Roost and square crowds, plus Stormwind's southern approach, monumental gate, Alliance-hero statues, bridges, mage tower and first commercial/residential blocks.

places/main/cells/x0z2.scene - Stormwind's northern districts: cathedral square/civic and residential buildings, tram portal, Dwarven forge/anvil and canal bridges, with Stormwind tags on district pieces.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - lake/creek approaches, road/farm dressing and the wolf-pack encounter manager.
places/main/cells/x-1z1.scene - western Garden Market region and garden-crowd population root, with authored wild mushrooms.
places/main/cells/x1z1.scene - hilltop village and village-crowd population root.
places/main/cells/objects.scene - separately authored/shared placed objects within the main place.
roots: templates/player.js#player - composed player behavior stack for movement, locomotion, home/travel/activity, gryphon mount, bending and fox/owl presentation.
templates/camera.js#camera - WoW-style camera root; body heading and look orbit with riding-aware third-person presentation.
places/main/config.yaml - main place terrain, site marks, water, materials and environment root.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene#wolf-pack - local wolf encounter manager and den population.
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene#folk-crowd / #town-crowd - district and square population managers; Stormwind scenery itself is static placed geometry, not a manager.
places/main/cells/x1z1.scene#village-crowd and places/main/cells/x-1z1.scene#garden-crowd - village and Garden Market population managers.
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - heightAt(ctx)/materialAt(ctx) contract used by terrain and terrain-relative placements.
scripts/lib/wow-steer.js - camera-relative WoW steering shared by player and camera/locomotion behavior.
scripts/lib/data/gryphon.js + scripts/lib/wynx-kit.js - Wynx tuning, modes, animation/audio and FX shared by mount and follower; FEATHERS also drives Wunix's fox/owl transformations.
scripts/lib/data/npc-models.yml - model/rig-height registry reused by folk, town, garden and village crowd managers.
scripts/lib/road-solid.js + scripts/lib/solid-kit.js - solid/collider mesh construction shared by road and site builders; road-solid exports winding-safe polygon/prism helpers.
scripts/lib/royal-kit.js - geometry/material helpers reused by royal and Stormwind procedural architecture builders.
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and home-interaction tuning.
scripts/lib/data/bending.js + scripts/lib/fct.js - bending/combat rules and combat-text event helper used by bender, wolf-pack and HUD.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); movement, identity presentation and gryphon ground-riding clearance.
scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber, onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - ride(), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt).
scripts/gryphon-mount.js - onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/wynx.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx,dt); scripts/lib/wynx-kit.js - FEATHERS, DUST, setMode, yawOf.
scripts/fox-companion.js - onSpawn(ctx), update(ctx,dt); changes Wunix's fox/owl form and selects travel/flying animation clips.
scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx); scripts/gen/soften.js - softened(geometry).

scripts/gen/stormwind-building.js - geometry(ctx); parameterized city block/building geometry; scripts/gen/stormwind-gates.js, stormwind-bridge.js, stormwind-monument.js, stormwind-mage-tower.js, stormwind-tram-portal.js and stormwind-anvil.js provide distinct city landmarks.
scripts/lib/road-solid.js - Q, T, solid, prism, box, ngon, gem; winding-aware solid geometry helpers.
scripts/folk-crowd.js, garden-crowd.js, town-crowd.js, village-crowd.js - crowd managers; scripts/sky-dragons.js - onSpawn, launch, roar, ears, update.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - movement intent, velocity, jump, flight, rope and camera mode; flyBoost scales flight speed; movement scratch/cached intent in ctx.session.
scripts/camera.js - camera.state.heading is body WoW heading; camera.state.off is separate orbit/look offset; publishes native orbit and collision distances.

scripts/gryphon-mount.js + scripts/wynx.js - mount behavior owns player riding/flyBoost transitions; Wynx owns unmounted follow position, yaw and animation mode; per-player mount scratch in ctx.session.gry.
scripts/fox-companion.js - Wunix-only form, animation and facing; fox/owl clip selection and travel samples in ctx.session.foxState.
scripts/bender.js + scripts/lib/data/bending.js - bending level/XP, HP/chi, stance/spells, cooldowns, target, combat and cast/channel state; tick scratch in ctx.session.
scripts/wolf-pack.js - wild-wolf HP, level, threat, target, status, death/respawn and combat; publishes summaries to place.state.wolves.

scripts/folk-crowd.js, garden-crowd.js, town-crowd.js, village-crowd.js - each manager owns its roster NPC spawn/route/pose and scheduling; scripts/lib/data/folk.yml owns shared district tuning, roster entries and dialogue.
scripts/sky-dragons.js - manager owns scheduled flight requests/live dragon IDs and flight poses; dragon entities carry path/time state.
flows: templates/player.js behavior stack -> player.js input/update -> player movement/flying state; humanoid-locomotion reads casting/riding and supplies the corresponding pose.
player Z/mount action -> gryphon-mount.js finds or spawns tagged Wynx, seats/dismounts rider and updates riding/flyBoost; wynx.js follows owner when unmounted.
player movement/flying + player.state.riding='gryphon' -> player.js ground saddle-height raycast/terrain clearance and hop; camera.js detects riding for third-person orbit.
gryphon-mount.js / wynx.js mode changes -> lib/wynx-kit.js setMode -> anim/gryphon.yml clips, spatial audio and speed FX; lib/data/gryphon.js supplies movement/follow tuning.
templates/player.js -> fox-companion.js; Wunix detection selects scripts/gen/animal-fox.js on ground or scripts/gen/owl.js while flying, with anim/fox.yml or anim/owl.yml clips.
fox-companion form transition -> lib/wynx-kit.js FEATHERS FX and transform sound; flying selects owl fly/glide/hover clips, landing returns to fox clips.
player movement/update -> fox/owl primitive-aware gentle flight bob; fox-companion reads player flying/velocity and travel speed to choose the current form and clip.
player inputs -> scripts/bender.js -> player bending/cast state and scheduled release/land/aoe handlers -> wild-wolf effects and damage.
bender damage/status/threat writes -> scripts/wolf-pack.js scheduled update -> combat, death/respawn and player rewards; summaries flow through place.state.wolves to bend-hud via ui.js.
scripts/lib/fct.js fct() -> uiEvent named fct -> scripts/ui.js onMount -> bend-hud text pool renders hit/heal/XP feedback.

places/main/config.yaml marks/seed -> forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt -> terrain, water and material bands; city grading/moat/canal/causeway marks coordinate Stormwind's placed scenes with the ground.

crowd roots -> district managers read roster YAML and npc-models.yml -> spawned model/rig or procedural actor, movement and pose; scripts/lib/data/folk.yml now includes royal-district roster and dialogue.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/tree-kit.js + forest-plant.js + valley-tree.js - seeded forest broadleaf, sapling, shrub and valley trees vary by kind, leaf palette, dimensions and LOD; bent trunks, root flares and puff canopies use gradient lighting.
scripts/gen/soften.js - reused by many scripts/gen builders; foliage-color faces get rounded mass normals while authored smooth/flat faces and broad flat surfaces retain their lighting.
scripts/gen/cob-house.js + cob-furnish.js - multilevel tree-centered home/furnishing varies by item, dimensions, palette and seed.
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js; town-lane.js + town-rampart.js - bridge and town-road/boundary geometry vary by dimensions, route, gaps and seed.

scripts/gen/stormwind-building.js + stormwind-gates.js / bridge.js / monument.js / mage-tower.js / tram-portal.js / anvil.js - Stormwind pale-stone/slate/timber city blocks and landmarks reuse royal-kit geometry; building shape, floors, dimensions, roof, color and detail vary by placed params/seed.
scripts/gen/town-square.js + town-kit/town-link.js - civic pieces, lamps, directional posts and named links vary by kind, layout and placed text.
scripts/gen/farm-crops.js, farm-fence.js, farm-props.js - crop rows, orchard props, pens, barns/mill and scarecrows vary by crop, points, style, item and seed.
folk-crowd.js, garden-crowd.js, town-crowd.js, village-crowd.js + npc-models.yml - model-backed NPC bodies/poses with procedural fallback and per-district routes/wardrobe.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain.
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used.
scripts/gen/garden-garb.js and scripts/gen/garden-wear.js - prior map found no current scene/template references.
scripts/gen/royal-cathedral.js and scripts/gen/royal-statue.js - prior map found no current scene attachments.
migrationNotes: forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main river is at sea level y=0, ground around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing near (0,-3); coordinate material IDs, terrain marks and decoration bindings.

Stormwind terrain marks are coupled to the scene layout: city floor near (0,190) at y=0.55, keep plateau near (65,330) at y=13.5, moats/canal beds at level 0/-1.6, and the causeway runs north from Spawn.

scripts/lib/road-solid.js Q/T orient each face away from an interior point; solid builds between equal-count loops and prism scales its top xz loop. Preserve convex loops and consistent vertex counts when changing callers.
Gryphon origin is rider feet; GRY.paws sets saddle/ground clearance. player.js terrain raycast/height, GRY.paws, mount geometry and unmounted Wynx ground-follow behavior are coupled.
Wynx lifecycle is keyed by player.state.riding='gryphon' and tagged wynx entity ownership; keep mount state, companion owner/ridden flags, camera detection and locomotion ride pose aligned.

Wunix flying swaps its primitive to scripts/gen/owl.js and anim/owl.yml; landing restores scripts/gen/animal-fox.js and anim/fox.yml. npc-models.yml supplies crowd actor heights, and model-backed poses use humanoid-locomotion.
